units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 8:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>האומר … קְטַע את ידי וכ׳</he> if one says to one’s neighbor, cut my hand off, he (who did so) is bound to pay damages.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:5">Ab. Zar. I, 5</cite> <he>קוֹטֵעַ את וכ׳</he> one may cut off its toe and sell the cock to the idolater.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:12">Ib. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>יִקְטְעֶנָּה</he>, v. <cite ref="N00372"><he>נוֹמִי</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="S00719"><he>קָטוּעַ</he></cite>.

B. Kam. 83ᵇ יכול … מְקַטֵּעַ את ידו (Ms. M. נְקַטֵּעַ) (from Ex. XXI, 24) you might think, if a person cut a man’s hand off, one (we, the court) should cut his hand off. Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 מְקַטְּעִין ויוצאין וכ׳ they (the waters) cut through and come forth between the mountains.—Part. pass. מְקוּטָּע; f. מְקוּטַּעַת; pl. מְקוּטָּעִים, מְקוּטָּעִין; מְקוּטָּעוֹת lopped, defective.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>שהיו אצבעותיהם מק׳</he> their fingers were mutilated (bitten off).—<he>חדשים מק׳</he> (or sub. <he>חדשים</he>) incomplete months, a fraction of the last month of pregnancy. Y. Bets. I, beg. 60ᵃ, v. <cite ref="O00332"><he>סוּם</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 21a:3">Bekh. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>אינה יולדת למק׳</he> an animal does not give birth before the due number of months is completed; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be cut off, crippled. Pesik. R. l. c. ונִתְקַטְּעוּ אצבעותינו our fingers were mutilated (by the handcuffs); Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII; Yalk. Ps. 884.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 21a:10">Taan. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>רגלי … יִתְקַטְּעוּ</he> may my feet that paid no regard to thy feet be crippled.
